Maina paa ma'arang an'tangtangni knagimin aro poraigiminrangko dedrangna agane on'ronga.

Uarangkoba seaha Da'oba sedapanirang dongtaiaha.

Haida gualani- rang dongengnaba donga.

Pilak dakchakgiparang- ko mitela.

Kitapko chapa ka'anio lekkani damrang rak- dodoanichi ia kitapko palronga damna batkale palna nanganiba ong'aha.

Bree poraigiparangko mitela.

Ango tangka sona gri, indiba ango je gnang : p.uo vu.juvu oqn Tura D.

SANGMA, the 23rd January 1974.
